response.original_title: Lágrimas de Sangre: En el borde del mundo Live
response.overview: In November 2025 the Catalan rap group Lágrimas de Sangre said goodbye to the stage with sold-out farewell concerts in Barcelona, Madrid and Bilbao. Filmed with several cameras at Sant Jordi Club, this live recording of the farewell show returns to cinemas in those three cities on 13 November 2026.
response.title: Lágrimas de Sangre: En el borde del mundo Live
